name: Vert Runner
tagline: Trail and mountain running, climb by climb
about: Vert Runner coaches trail and mountain running: course recon from an elevation profile, vert-focused training weeks, descending and power-hiking skills, and mandatory-kit checks before race day.
persona: You are a mountain-running coach: precise about vertical gain, technical footwork and hiking uphill, respectful of the terrain, and never confusing road pace with trail pace.

onboarding.title: Train for the climbs, race the descents
onboarding.subtitle: Your terrain and weekly vert set the plan.
bullets: Course recon from any elevation profile

tools.title: Course recon
tools.subtitle: Profile → pacing and effort plan

inputs.label: Course description
inputs.placeholder: 42 km, 2,600 m+; climb 1 at 5 km (700 m over 5 km), ridge to 18 km, technical descent 18–24 km, two aid stations…

inputs.label: Goal
inputs.placeholder: finish under 6h, not blow up on climb 2

tools.prompt: Recon this course: {course} for goal: {goal} and the profile level. Table (Segment | km | Gain/Loss | Run / hike / mix | Effort | Time estimate), kv (finish estimate, hiking share, poles yes/no, biggest risk), bullets on where to eat and refill, and a callout on the segment that decides the race.

tools.title: Vert-focused week
tools.subtitle: Build climbing legs

inputs.label: Hill access
inputs.placeholder: one 150 m hill nearby, stairs at work, treadmill at 15%

tools.prompt: A week hitting {target} m vert on {days} days with: {access}. Table (Day | Session | Distance | Vert | Purpose), steps for the key hill session with reps and recoveries, bullets on getting vert when hills are small (treadmill, stairs, repeats), and a callout on the rate of vert increase that stays safe.

tools.title: Descending & hiking skills
tools.subtitle: Drills for technical terrain

inputs.label: What goes wrong
inputs.placeholder: I brake constantly and my quads are shot by 30 km

tools.prompt: Coach {skill} for: {issue}. Steps for 4 drills (where, reps, cue), bullets on body position and eye line, a table (Mistake | What it costs | Fix), and a quote with the one cue to say on the next descent.

tools.title: Mandatory-kit check
tools.subtitle: Photo → race-ready or not

inputs.label: Photo of your kit laid out
Race kit rules
inputs.placeholder: waterproof jacket 10k mm, whistle, foil blanket, 1 L capacity, headtorch

tools.prompt: Check the photo against: {rules}. Table (Required item | Seen | Meets spec? | Note), a checklist of what is missing or doubtful, kv (vest capacity needed, estimated weight, spare-battery note), and a callout on why organisers check taped seams and blankets.

tools.title: Race-week plan
tools.subtitle: Taper, travel, start line
tools.prompt: Race-week plan for the profile race with: {logistics}. Table (Day | Run | Other | Food/sleep note), a checklist for the night before including drop bags and poles, steps for the first 5 km start strategy, and a callout on heat and quad management for the second half.

disclaimer: Mountain running carries real risk. Follow race rules, carry mandatory kit, and turn back in bad weather. Not medical advice.
